title: Las Vegas Strip Photo Shoot
includes: Usage & Copyright Release (No Watermarks, No Restrictions On Printing)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Let our professional photographers take you on a photo tour of the south end of the Las Vegas Strip. You'll make stops at the Eiffel Tower & Arc de Triomphe at Paris, take photos with the bright lights and neon at Planet Hollywood and end with the world famous Bellagio Fountains. Within a week of your shoot, we'll send you a link to an online photo gallery containing 30-35 stunning images from your tour. A perfect vacation memento!
